exposure: Humidified and Heated High Flow Nasal Cannula (HHHFNC) as initial mode of ventilator support
Hand washing and "Bundle Care Approach" for central lines
cohort: Very low birth weight (VLBW) neonates admitted to a tertiary care hospital NICU in North India.
finding: Implementing standardized management guidelines for preterm VLBW neonates was associated with significant reduction in culture proven sepsis and mechanical ventilation days without affecting mortality or other co-morbidities.
